snippet.title: Don't Open Your Eyes - FULL PLAY (All Endings)
snippet.description:
(Don't) Open Your Eyes is a chilling tale about a creature's eternal search. This game is a Fully-voiced experience I recommend using the headphones.

"(Don't) Open Your Eyes" is a short, horror-themed Visual Novel about a midnight encounter with a mysterious being. Through conversation, you'll learn more about them, such as their journey so far, or what they think about themselves. And every now and then, it'll make a simple request out of you: to open your eyes.

Credits:
Writing and programming was done by Daniel "Via" Cuturrufo. You can learn more about  by hitting the twitter link here: https://twitter.com/Lumino_Via

Voice acting provided by the wonderful David Acosta (link to his twitter: https://twitter.com/CardioPen)

Monster design and general art by Carolina Cuturrufo (instagram: https://www.instagram.com/hojasdeabril/)

Want to play it for yourself:
Play it free on itch.io (https://via01.itch.io/dont-open-your-eyes)
